transport.stdout: Exactly one compact JSON line: {"audit":<event>}; no logger message wrapping or pretty printing.
transport.archive: Router extracts the pure event; Fluent Bit Firehose output serializes one newline-delimited JSON record.

rules: Optional successful credential check uses status_id=1,severity_id=1,status_detail=AUTHENTICATED,user={name:'demo-user',type_id:1}; no production/session claim.
Allowed failure reasons INVALID_CREDENTIALS,MISSING_CREDENTIALS,MALFORMED_CREDENTIALS,INVALID_TOKEN,UNAUTHENTICATED; fixed allowlist not raw exceptions.
metadata.uid generated once; same value in response/log. OCSF time epoch milliseconds.
metadata.correlation_uid safe inherited action ID or generated. platform.request_id safe server/request ID. IDs bounded <=128 printable allowlist; header values no control chars <=512.
trace_id 32 lowercase hex nonzero, span_id16 lowercase hex nonzero from actual active OTel context; optional and omit absent, not empty strings. Keep when unsampled if active context valid.
aws_alb_trace_id sanitized X-Amzn-Trace-Id raw header <=512; optional aws_cloudfront_request_id sanitized X-Amz-Cf-Id when actually present <=512.
platform.route constant route template, auth_boundary demo_login|graphql|api_auth; no query/body. environment from DEPLOYMENT_ENVIRONMENT default local; service version existing SERVICE_VERSION.
Do not activate OCSF profiles requiring extra objects; this subset uses base Authentication fields. Need user name to satisfy OCSF user identity constraint; unknown literal explicitly sentinel.
Do not emit top-level actor/tenant/token/password/headers/raw_data/payload. Normal operational log can reference event UID/request/trace without full auth payload.

Endpoint POST /demo/auth/login body username,password strings max256,max1024. Disabled404; enabled requires nonblank DEMO_AUTH_USERNAME and DEMO_AUTH_PASSWORD; never hardcode demo password. Wrong/missing creds401, valid200. Bad JSON/shape may400 but do not log body.

Response401 {authenticated:false,message:'Invalid credentials',request_id:<id>,audit_event_id:<uid>,trace_id?:<valid-id>}. Response200 {authenticated:true,message:'Demo credentials accepted',request_id:<id>,audit_event_id:<uid>,trace_id?:<valid-id>}. Success event required if returning audit_event_id; otherwise can omit success id but coordinate UI.

No existing app auth behavior change. Endpoint authenticates only demo check, no cookie/session/token grant. Browser route proxy /audit-demo/{reservation|agent|recommendation}/login -> backend /demo/auth/login.
